description.value: Smoking Gun Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster and cafe located in the District 1881 development in the heart of downtown Chilliwack. The cafe serves a full range of hot and cold espresso drinks, filter coffee, matcha, teas, alternative milks, baked goods, and savoury sandwiches, with seasonal rotating options. The roastery side ships freshly roasted single-origin and blended beans Canada-wide, making it both a neighbourhood gathering spot and a draw for coffee-focused riders.
